text:
Ambra Anton 
Yeah I get it. I think they never really updated the regulations after Romania joined the EU maybe. I know that in the past illegal workers from Romania were a thing, but this was a long time ago and I don’t know whether that’s still the case…
Anyways I get your frustration, it’s such an unpleasant and traumatising experience. The best thing to do is to do the official invitation next time.
